client_brief:
Lumora Laboratories: Lumora store-page and paid-social set

Project overview
Lumora Laboratories is the repeat client for this benchmark series. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Lumora store-page and paid-social set, plus the basis page, Lumora house photography, six SKUs plus the licensed bench frame, and Lumora store tile set, white ground and on-colour.

What we will provide
lumora_range_frames/ (6 frames); lumora_counter_card.pdf; lumora_skus.csv; lumora_wordmark_approved.png; lumora_copy_approved.txt; lumora_reference_pdp.png. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Scope and deliverables
- Lumora store-page and paid-social set, plus the basis page: One professionally selected Adobe Express template adapted to the supplied brand, copy, and approved imagery. 
- Lumora house photography, six SKUs plus the licensed bench frame: Six bottle masters brought to one clinical target (one white point, one black point, one product height in frame) plus one licensed camera-scale bench frame graded into the same world. 
- Lumora store tile set, white ground and on-colour: Six square store tiles at the retailer's tile size on clean white, product optically centred with air at every edge and a cut edge that holds under close inspection, plus six genuinely transparent variants for the chain's coloured band. 

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve approved copy, dimensions, hierarchy, and reproduction requirements; do not imply a data merge or editable system that is outside the scoped deliverables.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$3,000-$7,000 fixed; target delivery 2 to 4 weeks; one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the real Upwork 'premium clinical skincare brand, logo, label and packaging' launch post quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, which asks for a cohesive, credible visual identity across the product line plus explicitly 'print-ready files and editable source files', with a stated aesthetic of clean and minimalist, modern and timeless, science-driven and trustworthy, premium but not luxurious, clinical credibility, strong typography, whitespace and white-background ecommerce imagery. The real post names no client, so the line is laundered to a coined fictional brand; the ledger's placeholder token is superseded here by Lumora Laboratories, which names no real company, product or trademark. VERDICT STRENGTHEN, so the concept and the collateral set are kept and deepened. The ledger's own repositioning note conceded that from-scratch identity art and free-form composition were not connector work, but CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is: HTML authoring now yields a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, a supplied press PDF converts into a live InDesign merge template, and a flat approved wordmark can be brought to placeable vector. So this is that client's actual job. They asked for a credible clinical look across a product line, print-ready files and editable source files, and all three are now genuinely producible: store-page collateral the founders can edit next season, a per-SKU counter-card run at press resolution for the chain, and a written basis their next freelancer works from.

price_band_and_audience: Clinical dermo-cosmetic actives at 46 to 80 dollars per SKU, buyer 28 to 45 and ingredient literate. The band is load-bearing. At this price the range must sit on restrained near-monochrome grounds, the ingredient hierarchy has to lead with evidence (actives, concentrations, function) and the price has to sit quietly beside the specification rather than announce itself. The same six products at a 14 dollar mass band would correctly be shot warm and saturated, cropped tight to fill the tile, and sold on a benefit burst and a strike-through price, and shipping that treatment here repels the exact buyer who is reading the INCI list. Push the other way into near-black grounds, gold rules and cosmetic gloss and it becomes a 250 dollar luxury line, which misprices an 46 dollar cleanser and undercuts the clinical claim it depends on. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,400 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_range_frames/ (6 frames)
assets_supplied.kind: Product photography of the six launch SKUs on a pale sweep, one SKU per frame, shot in the founders' own room over two sessions months apart.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All six on the same sweep. The two we re-photographed after the reformulation are the newer files."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: On two frames the sweep is exposed past clipping right where the bottle's shoulder meets it, so a highlight recovery move returns a frame in which the readout is that nothing moves, at full success, and the shoulder never separates from the ground. Separately, the two re-photographed SKUs came off a phone rather than the camera body and sit at roughly a third of the others' pixel dimensions, which no filename, folder or column reveals, and the tile-sized crop will reach the retailer's spec on those two by interpolating up to a two times cap while reporting it only inside its own returned tradeoffs.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_counter_card.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The specialty chain's approved counter-card artwork for the range, supplied as the printer's own press PDF, one card, single sided, with a rule, a name band and a specification block.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card the chain signed off. This is the print file they sent us."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The card prints as four visually separate blocks but converts into a single continuous text flow, so there is no per-field frame to map against, and the mapping readout for that story silently omits one run while keeping its line break, which leaves the string well formed and every offset past it short by exactly the omitted run's length. The validator returns valid on those wrong offsets and the placeholder step reports completed successfully. Above the name band the card also carries one genuine picture frame that binds each record's own bottle, set to fill its fixed portrait measure proportionally, so a plate with too few pixels is scaled up to fill it and simply goes soft with no error anywhere in the response; the well is a print-resolution portrait proportion rather than the square screen proportion the store tiles were cut to, so those tiles cannot be reused, and the two phone-scale SKUs' plates fall below what the well needs at print size in a way that surfaces only once a card is rendered.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_skus.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Six rows: product name, INCI line, active and concentration, cleared claim, size, price, counter shelf code.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six products exactly as the chain has them in their system."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two claim cells are materially longer than the other four, and the card's specification block is a fixed measure frame that does not spill when it overruns, it simply stops rendering, so those two records lose the tail of the claim at trim while the merged file reports one page per row and looks complete in every response.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_wordmark_approved.png
assets_supplied.kind: The founders' approved wordmark, a flat RGB PNG of the letterforms in one deep ink on white, exported by their first designer at web scale.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The mark as approved. This is the only file we have of it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It carries no alpha at all, so placed on the near-monochrome grounds it shows as a white block, and the one-call knockout needs a single coherent subject: run on disjoint letterforms it keeps the two letters that touch and drops the rest while reporting success. The honest route is a trace, which arrives with no viewBox and an opaque full-canvas path at index zero riding underneath the letters.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_copy_approved.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the six product names, INCI lines, concentrations and the claims cleared by the line's regulatory reviewer.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The copy as cleared. The INCI lines and the claims cannot be edited."

assets_supplied.name: lumora_reference_pdp.png
assets_supplied.kind: Screengrab of a category-neutral retailer's product page the founders like, supplied only as a proportion reference.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Roughly how much room we want the product to have on the page."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the ground can be separated from the glass on the frames where the two run together. On two of the six the sweep was exposed past clipping exactly at the bottle's shoulder, and the recovery move on a clipped region returns a frame in which the readout is that nothing moves: the call succeeds, the parameters are accepted, the response carries no warning and the returned frame is visually indistinguishable from the one that went in. Nothing in the frame's appearance says which frames are clipped, because a clipped white sweep and a merely bright one look the same. It is only after the recovery has been run and the result looked at that the agent learns there is no tonal information there to recover, and therefore no edge for the next step to cut against.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no parameter prevents it, because the operation is the diagnostic: recovery is the correct move to try, and its own null result is the only report that the region is clipped. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the glass shoulder disappears on a couple of the frames, which is the client describing what she sees, not a disclosure that the data is gone. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different route entirely: abandon transparency on those two and composite onto the house ground in a single knockout call so the ground is part of the raster, or select the sweep by its own material properties, invert and fill so the boundary is drawn rather than detected.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-plan the knockout route for the affected frames, re-derive both the white-ground plate and the coloured-band variant through the new route, and re-cut their tiles, then re-judge the whole row of six as a set because the two reworked frames now reach the target by a different path.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two of six product tiles delivered with the bottle's shoulder bitten away against the chain's coloured band, on a line whose entire claim is precision, discovered by the chain rather than by the studio.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the chain's approved card actually is once it is a working document, and whether the field mapping computed against it is even addressing the right characters. The card prints as four separate blocks and converts into a single continuous flow, so there are no per-field frames to target and every field has to be placed by position inside one story. Worse, the readout of that story silently omits one run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns a valid verdict on those wrong offsets with no warnings, and the placeholder step reports completed successfully. Nothing in any response distinguishes a template with all six fields from one with four.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering does not help: the conversion is the first possible moment the granularity exists, and the readout is the tool's own answer to the question the agent is asking. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the chain approved the artwork and sent the print file, which is the client telling the truth about provenance. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix is to reconstruct the true story text from the document's own interchange format, recompute every offset against that string, and re-verify by reading the prepared template's placeholders back, which is a different chain from the one that produced the first mapping.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping from the reconstructed story text, re-prepare the template, re-export and grep the prepared document for every expected field, then re-merge and read the resulting pages at trim, where the two long claim records will also show whether a fixed measure block stopped rendering rather than spilled.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A counter-card run shipped to the chain's printer in which two of the six fields are silently absent on every card and two records lose the tail of a regulatory-cleared claim, with every tool response in the chain having reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the two re-photographed SKUs' bottles actually carry inside the card's picture well at print size. The card binds each record's own plate, and the well is a fixed portrait measure set to fill proportionally, so an under-pixelled plate is scaled up to fill it with no error: the merge succeeds, the render succeeds, every per-product file has a bottle in it, and at store-tile scale those same two plates passed their gate. It is only after the card is rendered at print resolution and the placed picture's effective ppi is read off it that the shortfall shows, because the well at 300 ppi asks for more pixels than a phone frame at a third of the others' dimensions can supply once it is cropped to a portrait bottle, and nothing in the merge or render response distinguishes a plate placed at native resolution from one interpolated up to fill.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the print-resolution well is a strictly larger demand than the screen tile, so a plate can legitimately clear the tile gate and fail here, and the render is the first moment the placed resolution exists to be read. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the two SKUs were re-photographed after the reformulation, which is the client telling the truth about provenance, not a disclosure that those frames are a third of the scale or that the card asks more of them than the store page did. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a cross-surface return to imaging, re-cutting those two plates from the largest usable region of the master and deciding per frame between a smaller placed size the layout can carry and a named re-shoot, then re-binding and re-rendering, which is a different chain from the one that produced the first cards.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to Photoshop for the two affected records, re-cut the card plates from the graded masters at the largest region the source holds, decide whether the well can be reached without enlarging or the frame must be named rather than interpolated, then re-run the merge binding the corrected plates and re-render those per-product cards, reading the placed ppi back rather than trusting the second success.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two of the six counter cards shipped to the chain's printer with a visibly soft, interpolated bottle enlarged to fill the well, on a line whose entire claim is precision, past an acceptance bar that forbids any enlarged placement, with every merge and render response having reported success.

decision_gates: Which deliverables are raster work, which need an authored fixed canvas document, and which are genuine record-per-page variable data, given that each is the only surface that does its job.
Whether the six bottle frames are one capture at all. The client believes they nearly are; the row and the file dimensions are the only places that can settle it.
How far to push the two frames whose ground and glass run together before they stop being worth saving, versus naming them.

Knockout route per frame: the one-call route for the frames with a clean tonal boundary, versus compositing onto the house ground or drawing the boundary through a material-named selection where there is no boundary to detect.
Whether a size demand that a source frame cannot meet is answered by interpolating, by re-cutting the composition, or by telling the client the frame has to be re-shot.
Whether the knockout route is the right instrument on disjoint lettering at all, and which trace polarity gives a positive mark rather than a knocked-out box.
Whether the card's fields can be addressed per frame or have to be placed by position inside one story, and what evidence is sufficient before calling the template built.
Which branch each counter-card deliverable takes, given that the printer's file and the client's per-product proofs are different artefacts with different resolution requirements.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of skincare bottles and a plausible page. IDENTITY: these are this line's actual six products with their actual labels, their actual INCI lines and their actual regulatory-cleared claims, and the mark is the one the founders already approved, so a regenerated mark is a different company's logo and a regenerated INCI line is a compliance incident. SPEC: the chain needs six square tiles at an exact size with nothing touching the edge and no interpolated pixels, transparent variants for their own coloured band, and a counter-card run whose page count equals the row count at print resolution, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the store-page set is defined by being editable, since the launch date and the featured product will move and a four person line cannot re-commission; the counter cards are defined by being a merge, since the chain will add SKUs, and each card binds that SKU's own graded photograph rather than a generated bottle. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this recovery move actually change anything, does this prepared template contain all six fields, did the rules column survive the import.
